about_the_game:
Important Notes

This game is a work of fiction, and all characters are adults. The story background, character settings, and plot are all created for artistic purposes and have no connection to reality. Please do not draw parallels to real life.

Note: This game involves a large number of rhythm game-specific terms. It is recommended to play under the guidance of rhythm game players and with a lighthearted mindset. Avoid excessive immersion in the game. Those who are sensitive to such content should proceed with caution.

Later content may include psychological horror/abstract/disturbing/horrific/uncanny elements. Please play with discretion.

Game Background

In 20xx, arcade rhythm games quietly gained popularity in small towns.
Liu Xiazhe, who had clashed with his family over his obsession with rhythm games and had his tablet broken, chose to move alone to a small town for his studies. On campus, he struggled to find like-minded friends. Once, he had longed to meet someone who shared his interests, and even dreamed of a beautiful romance...

Until his sophomore year, Liu Xiazhe, who was passionate about rhythm games, accidentally encountered a unique arcade rhythm game.
From that moment on, his life became intertwined with four distinctive rhythm game girls.

Game Features

  • A rhythm game-themed narrative game set against a realistic backdrop, deeply reflecting the unique culture and atmosphere of rhythm game players.

  • Multiple branching storylines, including various ending routes such as the Overdrive Route, Transfem Route, Dance God Route, and Tech Route.

  • Drive the plot through player choices, experiencing different character relationships and story developments.

Additionally, the actual gameplay includes, but is not limited to, the following mechanics:

  • Scoring System. Players can obtain ratings through options or music games, and the value of the ratings will affect the direction of the plot and ending.

  • Phone Mode. In Phone mode, players can chat with the characters in the game. In addition, they can also view relevant forum posts to learn about various information.

  • Rhythm Game. In the plot, a music game will be set up for players to play, and they can play together with in-game characters!

Character Introductions

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains descriptions of drug-related content, sexual innuendos, and violence.
Characters in the game may occasionally use language that includes, but is not limited to, vulgarity, threats of violence, or sexual implications.
The game is set in a fantasy world where magic exists. Unscrupulous individuals profit by inscribing curses into candies. The curse takes effect anywhere from tens of minutes to several hours after consumption, during which victims may experience symptoms such as nausea and vomiting, accompanied by hallucinations, dissociation, and euphoria. The curse creates a strong psychological dependency, and long-term abusers who stop consuming the cursed candies suffer severe withdrawal symptoms, including extreme depression, anxiety, insomnia, and even bone pain.

short_description: "Love wmc" is a visual novel game based on music games. It tells a series of stories about the protagonist who came to a small county town to study alone due to family conflicts, and accidentally got involved with four female protagonists because of an arcade music game.
